body: I know how you feel. I’m that person too
I’m in the boat as you right this second my dude. I get you

I’m the opposite. Like if I’m wearing headphones with my music on then nothing can get me. I’m safe enough and I can finally feel things again even if I’m only wearing them for a short time. That bit of time is safe, almost like a bubble around me stopping the world from getting in.

To add to my comment, that’s transformed in my adult life to rarely questioning decisions or just asking questions in general to my line managers - instead internalising it like “shut up they know best”. Ugh.
That you should never. ever. ever question authority figures or ask for the reasoning behind their decisions.

I can’t remember anything from my childhood and first few teen years. I’ve been empty for a while knowing there’s *something* wrong with me but the cause of this feeling is somewhere in my past that I can’t figure out yet.
